name: africa-cdc-staff-portal
description: Root scripts mirroring helpdesk — orchestrate Laravel API (backend/) + Vue SPA (frontend/)

scripts.install:all: cd backend && composer install && cd ../frontend && npm install --cache ./.npm-cache --legacy-peer-deps
